marketing.v: M3 Max variant (j514m/j516m); BuildManifest selects the T6034 firmware class while ADT reports arm-io,t6031

reg.reason: The supplied ADT summary groups j514m/j516m under arm-io,t6031 and does not provide a distinct T6034 register set. Use t6031.json's cited per-board values; do not infer different registers.

interrupts.reason: No distinct T6034 interrupt set in the available summary; the j514m/j516m ANE nodes are included in the t6031 section.

die_topology.reason: The available T6034 BuildManifest rows are j514m/j516m M3 Max configurations; they do not establish a dual-die topology. T6034 is not evidenced as an M3 Ultra.

compatible.reason: INFERENCE, not measured: no ANE mailbox node exists in the ADT summary (S1) or in the kernel tree. t6034.dtsi (S4) includes t6031.dtsi, whose ASC mailboxes (smc, aop, mtp) are apple,t6031-asc-mailbox + apple,asc-mailbox-v4; that class is expected for the ANE, but no ANE node carries it. See t6031.json mailbox and receipts/2026-10-03-ane-h15.

pmgr.reason: No distinct T6034 PMGR values in the available ADT summary; the j514m/j516m systems use the T6031 PMGR data.

class.reason: 27.0 kernelcache was not fetched; no H15 ANE kext class or protocol strings extracted.

driver_family.reason: INFERENCE (b0 decision, receipts/2026-10-03-ane-h15): ane_t6021-like at the ASC layer, no new ASC-IOP client; the j514m/j516m ANE nodes are the T6031 ones (S1), so the t6031.json driver_family reason applies unchanged. Not measured: whether the firmware that iBoot preloads on an M3 Linux boot sends RTKit HELLO.
